items.answer: Phaseo stores each provider route's meter, unit size, currency, plan, and effective dates. Input and output rates remain separate, and token prices are normalized per 1M tokens for comparison; they are not combined into a blended headline price. Read the <pricingMethodology>pricing methodology</pricingMethodology> or enter your own token volumes in the <calculator>pricing calculator</calculator>.

Browse the <providers>provider directory</providers> for provider coverage, or filter the model directory by capabilities such as chat, embeddings, image, audio, video, and moderation. A provider page is the best place to check its currently listed model catalog.

Benchmark scores are shown alongside the benchmark and its methodology so that comparisons retain their context. Read <benchmarkMethodology>how Phaseo normalizes AI benchmarks</benchmarkMethodology> and <performanceMethodology>how it measures latency and throughput</performanceMethodology> before making a production decision from a single score.

Use the <contribute>contribution page</contribute> to report a correction or add missing information. Accurate, source-backed reports help keep the directory useful as providers change their catalogs and pricing.

mission.transparencyBody: Make pricing, routing, availability, lifecycle changes, and operational behavior understandable while keeping data and integrations portable.
